Subject: Q3 pipeline hygiene: EMEA & APAC commit sweep and finance check-in

Team,

Quick ask from finance ahead of our Q3 commit review: please update stages and commit statuses for all active EMEA/APAC opportunities by EOD Monday (2026-08-10). Finance will run the forecast after that cut. Specific guidance:

- Mark deals as: Commit / Commit - Contingent / Commit - At Risk / Not Commit.
- Update ARR and expected close date in HubSpot for any changes.
- Add one-line notes for any deals that moved from Commit -> Contingent.

I’m attaching a short checklist and a consolidated spreadsheet template for this sweep. We’ll run a 30-minute rollup on Tuesday to confirm final numbers. If you have procurement or contract blockers, loop in Neha and Vivek.

Attachments: EMEA-APAC-Commit-Spreadsheet-Aug2026.xlsx, Q3-Commit-Checklist.pdf

Thanks,
